A look at the work

See the salon's real bridal and makeup portfolio on Instagram — @charminghairandbeauty (6,591 followers). The photos here are samples showing the style of each service.

Makeup first, by Anam

Charming Hair and Beauty's Instagram leads with “makeupbyAnam” — and the reviews match: brides, formals and graduations book Anam for soft, feminine glam that still looks like them, with help right through to the bridal entry.

Around the makeup chair sits a full neighbourhood salon: threading, glow facials, skin care, hair removal, colour, cuts and protein hair spa — all under one roof on Glynburn Road, Hectorville.

Planning a wedding or big day? Call 0450 279 991 or message @charminghairandbeauty to talk dates — bridal bookings fill first.
